messages:
sasha.m: heads-up — CI canary deploy to ap-south-1 leaked decrypted SOPS values into pipeline logs and artifacts. GPU pool bootstrapping failing for the canary cluster. /cc @anna.k @lee :rotating_light:

devops-bot: build https://ci.internal/builds/5627 started by sasha.m
```
[10:12:03Z] INFO sops: decrypting secrets.yml
[10:12:03Z] DEBUG: SECRET_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY=ya29.A0AR... (decrypted)
[10:12:04Z] INFO: wrote /artifacts/secret-service.json (mode 600)
```

anna.k: omg, ok. immediate actions: 1) stop the canary deployment 2) remove artifacts from storage 3) rotate the exposed key if it's a service account. who can take 1 and 2 now? :eyes:

lee: i stopped the pipeline job and revoked the artifact temporary URL. quick root cause: our terraform apply step uses a helper script that sets SOPS_DEBUG=1 in CI for verbose logs when running in canary. someone merged the debug flag into the runner image last week. snippet from .gitlab-ci.yml:
```yaml
stages:
  - deploy

deploy-canary:
  image: registry.internal/redwood/ci-runner:canary
  script:
    - export SOPS_DEBUG=1  # <-- oops
    - sops -d secrets.yml > /tmp/clear.json
    - terraform apply -auto-approve
```

javier: we should never have decrypted secrets land in artifacts or logs. immediate mitigation: remove SOPS_DEBUG and add `SOPS_NO_LOG=1` (or equivalent). also add sops --output-type=json to avoid raw prints and change helper to `sops -d --output-type=json | jq -r .` and pipe directly to `kubectl create secret --from-file=/dev/stdin` so nothing touches disk.

sasha.m: affected region: ap-south-1 canary k8s cluster. symptoms: GPU nodes boot, but kubelet fails pulling images for runtime init because imagePullSecrets reference a secret that wasn't present (sealedsecret decryption failed on nodes). kubelet logs: 
```
Mar 20 10:14:21 kubelet[1234]: E030 10:14:21.123 kubelet.go:1234] Failed to pull image "gcr.io/redwood/gpu-init:latest": rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to resolve credentials: secret "registry-creds" not found
```

infra-cicd: created hotfix MR: https://git.internal/mr/8932 — removes SOPS_DEBUG, scrubs artifacts, and updates runner image. also kicked a jobs-scrub run to delete artifacts older than 1h. MR title: "ci: remove sops debug from canary runners + artifact scrub"

deploy-bot: rollback triggered by anna.k for pipeline build 5627 -> starting rollback to last-known-good commit (sha abcdef1234). rollback job: https://ci.internal/builds/5628

anna.k: rotation plan: if the key was a service account, we rotate now. if KMS alias was exposed we need to rotate alias and re-encrypt sealed-secrets for the canary cluster. who owns KMS in ap-south? @javier?

javier: i'll rotate the service account keys and trigger sealed-secrets re-encrypt for ap-south canary only. plan id: kms-rot-2026-0320-01. will post when done. :thumbsup:

lee: follow-ups: 1) add CI lint check to fail if SOPS_DEBUG or DEBUG envs are present in pipeline config 2) ban writing decrypted files to artifacts (enforce /dev/null usage) 3) add a pre-apply check that refuses to run terraform apply if secret environment variables appear in logs. i'll open a follow-up ticket.

sasha.m: thanks all. monitoring GPU pool status now. i see nodes coming back but we'll keep the canary paused until sealed-secrets re-encrypt completes. :white_check_mark:

devops-bot: scrub job completed: artifacts deleted (build 5627). kms-rotation status: rotating -> in_progress.

anna.k: good work. postmortem please include which runner image introduced the debug flag and add an ops blameless note about rotating any exposed credentials within 1 hour. :memo:

javier: kms rotation finished, re-encrypt job queued. will update when sealed-secrets controller reports success.

lee: opened ticket INFRA-4291: "prevent sops debug in CI + artifact leak protections" and linked MR 8932.

sasha.m: closing for now — will reopen if any regression. :lock:
